description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing a tree UI component using Ext JS framework, including features like saving/restoring tree state, handling expand/collapse events, and initializing the tree with configuration data.

classes.name: TreePanelState
classes.description: A class managing the save and restore of tree panel state using local storage, handling expand/collapse events, and restoring tree state on page load.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the TreePanelState by retrieving saved state from local storage.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current tree state to local storage.

methods.name: onExpand
methods.description: Handles node expansion, updating the saved state.

methods.name: onCollapse
methods.description: Handles node collapse, updating the saved state.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the tree state from saved data, expanding nodes accordingly.
